Native subagents / Squad routing08:30-10:30

Give parallel work separate owners.

LaneOwnsHands off
terraform-coderWrites the scoped Terraform diff and no other files.Changed files, assumptions, and unresolved questions.
terraform-validatorRuns fixed offline checks: fmt, init -backend=false, validate, tflint, tests.Exit codes, logs, and the exact command block.
terraform-reviewerReviews in a fresh read-only context after the diff exists.Findings, accepted scope, and next owner if rejected.
Squad / ScribeRoutes work and records public decisions..squad\decisions\inbox\ entry for later merge.

Give each parallel lane a named owner.
One writer per shared surface; validation and review stay independent.

$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
$env:TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE = (Resolve-Path '..\offline\terraform.tfrc').Path
$env:CHECKPOINT_DISABLE = '1'; $env:TF_IN_AUTOMATION = '1'

function Check($id, $exe, [string[]]$argv) {
  $log = "..\evidence\c7-$id.log"
  if (Test-Path $log) { throw 'Result already exists.' }
  "$exe $($argv -join ' ')" | Set-Content $log
  & $exe @argv 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log -Append
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $code | Set-Content "$log.exit.txt"
  if ($code) { throw "$id failed: $code" }
}

Check example terraform @("-chdir=$e",'test','-var-file','terraform.tfvars.example','-no-color')

GHAS / MCP / skills / testsAPPENDIX / reference only

What AI found that the scanners did not.

GHAS baseline, zero open

CodeQL, secret scanning with push protection, Dependabot.
Module: six checks. Demo env: Terraform Validate, Checkov, TFLint, Trivy.

Found by the agent

Checkov skipped main.tf since August. A scan was off for inactivity.
A monitor was falsely green. Two approval and cleanliness races.

Made checkable

Learn via MCP for product rules. Skills for secrets and review.
52 module contract cases plus 2 caller/example cases, 29/29 Online security checks, a human on every merge.

Working tipGHAS sees code, secrets, and advisories. Silent gaps need an agent and an oracle.

Issues routed by squad:{member} labels; Ralph keeps it moving.
A rejected change is revised by a different author.
